job.title: Workplace Support Engineer - Audio Visual
job.description:
About Company

A unique AV integration business with business hubs in across Melbourne, Sydney and Brisbane are looking to bring a technically minded Workplace Support Engineer into the business.  The business specializes in delivering MS Teams and Zoom meeting rooms for corporate and government clients.
  
About the role
You will be the go-to person across a few clients providing support for platforms and hardware. Resolving support issues, liaising with vendors & troubleshooting where required. It will be 50% remote & 50% travelling to sites where needed, involving training end users to support platforms.

Requirements
  • Experience supporting Microsoft Teams / Zoom environments
  • Crestron / Logitech / Yealink
  • Worked across corporate/enterprise clients
  • M365 exposure preferred
  • Hands on capabilities - this can be learnt
  • Customer facing skills
  
Bonus
  • $100,000-$110,000 +Super + Car
  • Work remote 50% of the role - travel to customer site as required
  • Opportunity to advance their career as a Project Engineer.
  • Further education/certifications are encouraged

job.title: Site Supervisor - Melbourne based AV Intregartor - RDO's on offer
job.description:
The Company:
The business are a long standing and highly reputable Audio-Visual and core technology business that specialize in the most up to date and latest collaboration between AV and workplace technology systems.
  
The Role:
  
This position is for an Audio-Visual Site Supervisor to be responsible for a team of 6 technicians and to help run the full installation process onsite with clients. Although managerial you will still need to get involved with the install activities and have a good understanding of the software systems that sit behind the solutions.
  
Key Criteria Needed:
  
  • Over 5 years of experience working within the AV industry within the integration side of the market
  • Lead and supervise on-site AV installations and day-to-day workflow
  • Proven experience with systems and equipment such as Crestron, QSYS, Yealink, Logitech, Commbox, ViewSonic, Poly, Shure etc
  • Communicate clearly with clients and keep them informed of progress
  
Bonus
  • Join a growing integrator - modern AV
  • $120k – $140k per year
  • Car Allowance
  • RDO's on offer

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
The Company:
  
A boutique AV integration business with business hubs in both Sydney and Brisbane are looking to bring a technically minded Account Executive into the business.  The business specializes in delivering MS Teams and Zoom meeting rooms for corporate and government clients.
  
The Role:
  
The position is focused on converting warm incoming leads into sales and helping walk clients through the technical side of the integration.  You will not be doing any new business as currently there are more leads coming in than the ability to service them.
  
Ideally, you will have some technical knowledge in the AV space so you can talk credibly about the integration and AV/VC environments.
  
Requirements for the role:
  
  • 2+ years working in either a technical support of sales focused role with the AV industry 
  •  Strong consultative sales ability, not looking for a hardnosed new business person but someone that can build strong relationships and convert incoming warm leads 
  • Knowledge of meeting room packages (Yealink, Logitech, Crestron) 
  • Ability to draw up requirements and run the sales process from end to end 
  
What's on offer:
  
  • Huge upside with the commission, ability to double your base salary over the years with uncapped comms
  • Work remotely - only need to visit client site and office when needed no requirements for a regular / weekly office visit 
  • Work with some technical experts and build on their knowledge base

job.title: IT Support 1st / 2nd line
job.description:
The Company:

This organization are a global technology company with its roots out of Australia but has spread across multiple countries and continents.  They are looking to hire an IT Support professional that can be the dedicated support function for the external clients of the business.

The Role:

You will be the responsible for all level 1 and 2 support queries that originated form the 20+ accounts that use the company's technology.  Typical quires will be focused on the technical windows environment and will include hardware support as well as excellent levels of customer service to the clients.
The position will be working on a 4-day work week with hybrid working to allow you both office based work and remote / WFH. 

You will also be asked to do on call weekend work and will be paid on top of your annual salary. You receive a daily on call allowance and any hours worked during the weekend will be paid at 150% of your normal hourly rate.
  
Key Skills / Experience:
  • Technical support experience in an IT focused or core hardware role 
  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Windows OS and ability to troubleshoot
  • Have an Australian permenat working rights and preferably a valid car license 
  • Quick learner that can pick up new technology 
  • Solid client facing and customer service skill set
Benefits:
  • Fast progression with role and salary increases to quickly move your career upwards 
  • Company has full health cover pre-paid for you (private health)
  • Work with cutting edge technology and become a real specialist
